reward.first_success_timing: NOT_MEASURABLE: saved scores are terminal-only; causal prefix/chunk scores absent
limitations: All videos already used for development; internal held-out split is not independent qualification.
Terminal native success differs from success_once; H750 calibration does not qualify H400/H600.
Thresholding changes the reward contract and requires separate calibration and cache identity.

noise.selection: 20 selected anchor failures/task, not a random task population; H600 final-state outcomes
noise.interpretation: Mixed outcomes show motor-noise headroom. Best-of8 is an oracle ceiling, not a realizable selector or evidence of adaptation. All-fail/all-success are observed 8-draw classes, not known probabilities 0/1. A negative between-case variance estimate is retained, not silently clipped.
